_source: OpenAI API list prices (USD per 1M tokens), from the OpenRouter model catalog 2026-11-11; the gpt-6.2 rows were re-verified on 2026-11-19 against the OpenRouter OpenAI standard endpoint and the public AICodeMirror model-pricing API, which agree row for row
_note: Long-context surcharge above 272k prompt tokens (2x input / 1.5x output on the official page) is not modelled. The gpt-6.2 rows therefore quote only their standard (<=272k) rates; their >272k rows (gpt-6.2-sol 4/15/5/0.2, gpt-6.2-astra 16/60/20/0.8) are deliberately left out of this document instead of being folded into one blended number. openai / host-codex are the same Codex service and are priced and grouped with codex.
